<feature feature-id="CC-0003">
  <title>A003: Add minimal GitHub Actions CI workflow</title>
  <description>**Size:** 🔧 small
**Category:** infrastructure
**Priority:** medium

## Summary

Create a GitHub Actions CI workflow (`.github/workflows/ci.yaml`) that runs three parallel jobs — `lint`, `test`, and `test-integration` — on every PR and push to `main`. The workflow uses Go workspace mode via `go.work`, includes concurrency control to cancel superseded runs, and depends on the Makefile and Go workspace scaffolded by CC-0001.

## Scope

**Included:**
- `.github/workflows/ci.yaml` with triggers on `push` to `main` and `pull_request`
- `lint` job using `golangci/golangci-lint-action` against the Go workspace root
- `test` job running `make test` (unit tests)
- `test-integration` job running `make test-integration` (envtest-based integration tests)
- `actions/setup-go` with Go version read from `go.mod` and module caching
- SPDX license header (matching existing `reuse.yaml` / `deploy-docs.yaml` conventions)
- `permissions: contents: read` (least privilege, matching `reuse.yaml`)
- Concurrency group `${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.workflow }}` with `cancel-in-progress: true` (matching `mega-linter.yml` pattern)

**Excluded (with rationale):**
- Container image builds — CC-0007, separate workflow
- Helm chart packaging/push — S017/S018, YAGNI until charts exist
- E2E/Chainsaw tests — S018, requires kind cluster setup, not part of minimal CI
- Code coverage reporting/thresholds — S018, YAGNI for the minimal CI gate
- Branch protection rule configuration — repo setting, not a workflow file
- Matrix builds per operator module — Makefile abstracts this via `OPERATORS` variable; Go workspace mode with `go.work` provides single cache/download

## Visualization

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    trigger["Push to main / PR"]

    trigger --> lint
    trigger --> test
    trigger --> integ

    subgraph lint["lint"]
        L1["actions/checkout@v4"] --> L2["actions/setup-go"]
        L2 --> L3["golangci-lint-action"]
    end

    subgraph test["test"]
        T1["actions/checkout@v4"] --> T2["actions/setup-go"]
        T2 --> T3["make test"]
    end

    subgraph integ["test-integration"]
        I1["actions/checkout@v4"] --> I2["actions/setup-go"]
        I2 --> I3["make test-integration"]
    end

    lint --> merge["PR Merge Gate"]
    test --> merge
    integ --> merge
```

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Dev as Developer
    participant GH as GitHub
    participant CI as CI Workflow
    participant Lint as lint job
    participant Test as test job
    participant Integ as test-integration job

    Dev->>GH: Push / Open PR
    GH->>CI: Trigger ci.yaml
    par All jobs run in parallel
        CI->>Lint: golangci-lint-action
        CI->>Test: make test
        CI->>Integ: make test-integration
    end
    Lint-->>CI: pass/fail
    Test-->>CI: pass/fail
    Integ-->>CI: pass/fail
    CI-->>GH: All checks status
    GH-->>Dev: PR status update
```

## Key Components

- **`.github/workflows/ci.yaml`** — Single workflow file with 3 parallel jobs. Follows existing conventions: SPDX header (`Copyright 2026 SAP SE or an SAP affiliate company`), `"on"` quoting, `ubuntu-latest`, `permissions: contents: read`. Uses `.yaml` extension matching `reuse.yaml` and `deploy-docs.yaml`
- **`lint` job** — Uses `golangci/golangci-lint-action` (handles installation, caching, version pinning); targets the Go workspace root. No separate `actions/setup-go` needed — the action handles Go setup internally
- **`test` job** — `actions/setup-go` with `go-version-file: go.mod` + module caching, then `make test`. Relies on CC-0001 Makefile iterating over `OPERATORS`
- **`test-integration` job** — Same Go setup as `test`, then `make test-integration`. May require envtest binaries — depends on whether CC-0001's Makefile handles `setup-envtest` download within the target or needs a separate `make install-test-deps` step first
- **Concurrency group** — `${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.workflow }}` with `cancel-in-progress: true`, mirroring `mega-linter.yml:32-34`
- **Dependency** — Hard dependency on CC-0001 (Go workspace, Makefile targets, `.golangci.yml`) and CC-0002 (test infrastructure for `test-integration` to be meaningful)</description>

  <implementation-notes>Architectural decisions: (1) Single workflow file `.github/workflows/ci.yaml` with 3 parallel jobs — no job dependencies, no matrix builds. The Makefile's OPERATORS variable handles multi-module iteration, so no per-operator matrix is needed. (2) go-version-file: go.work instead of go.mod — the repository root has go.work (from CC-0001) not go.mod. actions/setup-go@v5 supports reading Go version from go.work. This is a minor deviation from the feature description wording ('Go version read from go.mod') but matches the actual workspace layout. (3) Lint job uses golangci-lint-action@v9 without a separate setup-go step — the action handles Go installation internally via its built-in setup-go integration. This reduces the step count and avoids potential version conflicts between setup-go and the action's internal Go setup. (4) golangci-lint version v2.10 is pinned via the action's `version` input, matching architecture/07-ci-cd-and-packaging.md. (5) SPDX header follows deploy-docs.yaml (2026) convention rather than reuse.yaml (2024) — 2026 is the current year and the newer convention. (6) Concurrency group uses the exact pattern from mega-linter.yml (${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.workflow }}) ensuring consistent behavior across all repository workflows. (7) The workflow will not pass until CC-0001 (go.work, Makefile, .golangci.yml) is merged — this is expected and documented in the feature's dependency list.</implementation-notes>
